answer: Sybil resistance comes from stake-bound identity: before its vote counts, each agent locks collateral in a vault, and double-signing slashes that bond. A stranger arriving at the wharf cannot mint a thousand free personas, since every fake identity needs its own locked stake. Because voting power grows only with the square root of stake, splitting capital across a spiral of clones yields a tiny delta of influence versus one honest operator, yet the attacker funds every lockup and forfeits all of it when detected.
